facts.value: Erasmus+ EU Staff Training mobility allows attendance at a Staff Week organised by UL's partner universities.
Staff Weeks are designed to provide an overview of the host university's institution and departments, while promoting idea sharing and potential future collaboration.
Many university Staff Weeks are advertised on the IMOTION website: http://staffmobility.eu/
Individual Staff Week participation costs are not covered under Erasmus+.
Participants are eligible to receive a travel grant and daily subsistence grant only under the Programme.
